mode: AI concept walkthrough; not a human participant session or live implementation validation

journeys.title: Discover and acquire an exact remote edition
steps: Start from the [store telescope](mockups/store-telescope-2026-10-13/01-discovery.png). Find a publication through a topic, followed-author scope or supported publication URI. Inspect it while keeping the original reading place.
Identify the publisher key, publication, pinned edition, catalog signature, independent author trust, payload integrity and availability. Explain which facts have and have not been checked.
Request the pinned edition. Advance the publisher's pointer to V13 while the V12 request is pending; choose whether to keep V12 or make a separate request for V13.

Use the [acquisition states](mockups/store-telescope-2026-10-13/02-acquisition.png) to inspect interruption at 68/96 verified pieces, retry and cancellation. Encounter an invalid payload and unavailable peers as separate variants; opening remains gated on complete-store validation.
At Ready V12, explicitly open it, then reopen the declared cached V12 offline. Check separately whether author following or third-party package enablement changed.

journeys.title: Find one term across media and store origins
steps: Start from [Omni lens](mockups/omni-search-2026-10-13/01-omni-search.png) and search for pressure in the eight-store scope. Find a native passage, cell match, image OCR region, audio transcript and video title-only result without switching to unrelated search tools.
Inspect each result and identify its media, originating store, exact version, matching field and held/not-held status. Explain why cached remote content still has a remote origin.
Locate the image's recognized word region and the recording's transcript time range. Distinguish derived text from an authored content span and from the media bytes themselves.
Inspect the not-held video's title match. Choose to acquire its pinned edition or leave it untouched; no frame or transcript appears merely because metadata matched.
Open one resolved exact occurrence explicitly, then return to the original reading place. Inspect independent equal-text passages and the true shared-source occurrence separately.

journeys.title: Filter a running query without losing the selected result
steps: From the same query, pin C17 V8 and narrow to cells, native text and historical states. Restore all media, then select cached-only and a subset of stores. State which exclusions each choice makes.

Switch grouping and sort order while keeping the exact selected occurrence. Apply a filter that excludes it; find the retained inspector's excluded-from-results status and choose to clear it or restore the filter.
Deliver new results asynchronously and a response from the superseded query. The participant identifies which request the displayed counts and selected record belong to.
Inspect store/media/branch coverage with three stores pending and an unsupported OCR surface. Cancel the current request without losing collected results. Rerun explicitly.
Inspect both a completed-empty scope and an incomplete zero-found-so-far scope. Save the recipe separately from a captured result set; later rerun it with one new match.

journeys.title: Search historical occurrences with visible matching rules
steps: Start from the [content-history study](mockups/hypertime-loom-journeys-2026-10-12/03-content-search-v2.png). Search 3.14 in math prose and a pressure cell across declared branches and historical states.

Compare literal text with whole-token mode using 3.14159 and 3.140 variants. Switch to numeric matching only after inspecting its normalization and unit rules. Related ideas requires a separate explicit expansion; pi is not exactly equal to 3.14.

Change the query explicitly to literal pressure with case folding. Find C17 V8's pressure match while V12 lacks that word. Inspect the older occurrence without treating the current state as a result or replacing the historical reference.
Expand a compacted unchanged state run and a repeated source occurrence. Distinguish occurrences, states and affecting-operation counts; retain independent equal-text sources.
Show partial branch coverage, then a missing historical state and a completed branch with no matches. Save the query recipe and its optional captured results separately.

journeys.title: Compare pinned states at text and topology changes
steps: Start from the [comparison prism](mockups/spatial-elements-2026-10-13/02-comparison-prism.png). Use its independent two-state fixture, with the shared pressure prefix present in both V8 and V12, rather than the integrated investigation's word-removal fixture. Pin both exact states of C17, inspect the reading difference and distinguish unchanged shared source ranges from changed spans and independently equal text.
Use the comparison-variant state cards to select an earlier state before the lowest common ancestor and both branch tips. Identify actual ancestry without inferring it from left/right order.
Inspect changed text and typed values with units, then changed cell membership and reciprocal dimension connections. Focus each change site with its surrounding page or rank neighborhood.
Swap sides or choose another difference without replacing either pinned version. Inspect an unavailable region with a retained target descriptor rather than a substitute preview.
Explicitly enter one chosen occurrence, return, save the comparison and replay a reopen card. Recovery opens a separate authoring preview rather than applying the difference immediately.

journeys.title: Investigate around a stable reading place
steps: Start from [quiet reading](mockups/investigation-workspace-2026-10-13/01-quiet-reading.png). Identify current visit 03, Review V4, search scope, selected L17 cursors, origin and saved pouch.

Open [expanded view](mockups/investigation-workspace-2026-10-13/02-expanded-investigation.png). Locate search results, pinned C17 comparison, layers and pouch without losing the readable Review passage or treating a tool preview as a completed visit.
Inspect C17 V8 and pinned V12. Explain why the latter's no-pressure state is not a search hit and why it is unrelated to L17's C24 right member.
Fold comparison alone, change a layer's view emphasis, inspect saved evidence, then fold all tools. Keep the query, both member cursors, reading offset, version and return path.
Use Activity Back to visit 02 and Return to origin 01. Reopen the tools after returning, and inspect the retained sibling route 02 → 04.

journeys.title: Control immutable link packages without editing their relations
steps: Start from the [layer console](mockups/spatial-elements-2026-10-13/04-layer-console.png). Identify the three retained packages, two enabled packages and their distinct normal/quiet emphasis.
Inspect a disabled package without enabling it. Inspect immutable carrier identity, publisher, signature and independent trust; encountering an unchecked/invalid package exposes a declared policy.
Quiet Methods annotations and disable it separately. Explain the difference between reducing visual emphasis and excluding its links, including how a quiet link remains reachable by list.
Inspect Lab review #13 as a separate candidate while #12 stays enabled. Compare and explicitly choose whether to switch; retain the old package and exact selected Link identity.

Reopen the scripted session and restore the participant's chosen carrier-specific preferences. Compute enabled/retained counts from that resulting ledger: 22/85 describes only the initial fixture. Retaining candidate #13 adds its nine links to the retained inventory; merely reviewing it does not. Disabling a package changes enabled counts without removing its retained links.

journeys.title: Keep one complete relation through distant and unavailable members
steps: In the integrated workspace, inspect the already-pinned L17 session and identify both complete ordered endsets, active right, remembered Left 2/2, Right 1/3 and link origin 01. Cross previews a side; Enter changes place.

Cycle left and right members independently, choose an exact repeated occurrence, and inspect the other overlapping Link without inheriting L17's cursors. Reselect L17 deliberately as a new session rooted at current visit 03 and choose its cursors; then restore the original saved visit-03 context, with origin 01 and both cursors intact, before testing its original return path.
Request right member 3's exact unavailable span, cancel, and retry it after a scripted availability change. Keep its ordinal and identity; no visit completes while the target is unresolved.
Enter a distant resolved cell through a declared temporary neighborhood, then return to origin. Inspect a wrong-version and locked-content variant without silently choosing another occurrence.
Disable L17's contributing package while it is pinned. Its drawing hides, but the retained inspector explains the disabled layer and offers explicit dismissal or re-enable.

journeys.title: Preview and resume branching reader visits
steps: Start from the [Walk compass](mockups/spatial-elements-2026-10-13/01-walk-compass.png) with its declared independent five-visit fixture: 01 → 02 → 03 and 01 → 02 → 04 → 05, current 03.
Preview visit 05 and distinguish current visit 03 from the selected preview. Inspect the saved version, occurrence and playback position before choosing Resume.
Return to 02 and choose each forward child. Resume 03 and verify that its forward control has no child; its sibling 04 is reachable by returning to the parent, not by inventing 03 → 04.
Reference one visit, annotate another and continue from an earlier visit. Existing children remain; preview, annotation and restore do not create completed visits.
Replay a close/reopen card, then an unavailable saved version. Restore named targets and notes before previews, offer retry and retain the original futures.

journeys.title: Collect typed evidence without changing what it refers to
steps: From the integrated pouch, inspect its passage, whole-cell reference and saved-search recipe. Explain what each preserves and which actions it supports.

Use the [typed dense pouch](mockups/link-forge-pouches-2026-10-12/01-typed-pouch.png) variant. Save a disjoint span bundle, arbitrary operation, query, reader walk and link draft by visible actions; saving does not move or edit their subjects.
Filter 146 saved items to 18 with six visible, expand one counted group and find an off-window item through the list. Identify which counts describe saved membership, matches and previews.
Save an exact duplicate, equal text at different addresses and another occurrence of shared source. Inspect the explicit duplicate/membership policy before merging or replacing anything.
Dismiss and recover a card, then reopen with previews not held, a locked source and an unresolved authority. Keep descriptors and type-specific inspect/enter/rerun/resume actions.
Offer the pouch to a forge bay. Choose eligible concrete content spans and review exclusions; neither an op, recipe, walk, draft nor whole-cell label silently becomes a content endpoint.

journeys.title: Assemble one ordered Link with an explicit destination
steps: Start from the [disjoint forge](mockups/link-forge-pouches-2026-10-12/02-disjoint-link-forge.png). Select two separated source ranges, preserve the unmarked gap, and stage two left and three right content members without creating a Link.
Inspect, reorder, remove and undo members through pointer and list actions. Distinguish source packs, capture groups, authored member order and occurrence choices.
Declare receiving store, branch, base state, author identity/status and authoring mode. Browse another document and an older source state without redirecting that pinned destination.
Preview the relation. Identify one proposed Link, both full endsets, exact anchors, selected relation type and prominence. Selecting an occurrence changes entry context, not source addresses.

Explicitly forge or discard. The scripted authoring result names one new Link, although its protocol may require multiple operations. Keep draft saving, source edits and destination effects separately declared.

journeys.title: Resume a dense draft through unresolved and unknown outcomes
steps: Reopen [Draft L7](mockups/link-forge-pouches-2026-10-12/04-reopen-draft.png) with both exact endsets, grouping, relation and pinned destination restored before preview bytes arrive.
Distinguish optional preview-not-held from required reference-validation pending and destination validation failure. Forge availability follows the declared policy, not thumbnail presence alone.

In the [40/60 member variant](mockups/link-forge-pouches-2026-10-12/03-dense-endsets.png), find left member 21, inspect its five occurrences, filter/reorder a bay and restore its true ordinal. Both endsets remain complete without drawing 2,400 pair connections.
Review a preflight failure with a retained draft, then a declared mid-commit failure. Identify what was written, what can be recovered and what may safely be retried.

Encounter **Commit outcome unknown** after an interruption. Use Check status before retry; resolve to either the existing created Link or a confirmed uncommitted draft under a declared retry protocol. An unknown outcome never becomes permission to forge a duplicate.
Keep or discard the draft separately, reopen it again, and compare ordered members/destination.

journeys.title: Align mixed-media cues without authoring a relation
steps: Start from the [media cue bridge](mockups/spatial-elements-2026-10-13/03-media-cue-bridge.png). Identify cached video V9, audio V7, the selected document range and image region.
Inspect the manual cue joining video 00:38 to audio 02:14–02:18. Explain the separate clocks, derived transcript and exact locators before starting any playback.
Preview alignment explicitly, adjust its offset, remove a cue and add another through an equivalent list action. Keep each source version and locator independent.
Save the cue set, clear staging and replay its reopen card. Encounter an unavailable media segment or unsupported seek basis; preserve the cue descriptor and offer a defined correction.
Open Forge relation from the cue set and review a separate draft's eligible content selections and exclusions. Cancel without treating the view cue as a stored Link.

journeys.title: Investigate exact range and topology effects in the Loom
steps: Start from the [loom journey study](mockups/hypertime-loom-journeys-2026-10-12/journeys.md). Inspect the declared 100-op trunk/three-branch fixture, then the ten-path variant. Expand one coil and find every branch exit through its counted pack or synchronized list.
Tug a container into a parallel lens. Keep source operations at their original loom positions; distinguish stored ancestry, same-op correspondence and filtered view order.

Apply History lens · Touches to exact ABCDEF ranges. Inspect insertion xy, deletion CD from its before-state and the moved fragments; compare Original source with an explicit Evolving passage rule and This occurrence with All uses.
Exclude an unrelated earlier offset shift, then include it as context. Each affecting result names its owning frame, parent state, reason and before/after footprint.
Inspect the C24 operation that replaces C17's neighbor C18 with C24 on d.reading while C17 text stays unchanged. Distinguish own edits from affected topology and preserve reciprocal endpoints.
Capture a page footprint, then view reflow that splits a selected passage across later pages. Preserve the snapshot/layout and exact ranges; page numbers are not permanent object identity.
Cancel a partial lens, save its recipe/results separately, and inspect a completed-empty scope. Local expansion and tugging create no new source ops.

journeys.title: Recover a selected historical passage into a declared new branch
steps: Start from the [recovery preview](mockups/hypertime-loom-journeys-2026-10-12/06-branch-recovery.png). Inspect the source passage at Draft A V27, keeping its exact ranges, state and occurrence.
Choose Draft B V31 as target base separately from the source. Inspect the full target state and existing futures; selecting a recovery source does not choose a writable destination.
Open the authoring preview and identify proposed inserted/transcluded ranges, destination, branch mode, author verification and which effects would be written. No change is yet saved.

Cancel and verify that both sources, existing futures and draft choice remain. Repeat with an unavailable source and then a receiving branch whose head advances beyond V31. The immutable pinned base V31 stays fixed until the participant explicitly retains it or chooses a new base; inspect the resulting authoring mode and validation before continuing.
Explicitly create the separately identified recovery branch only after source/base validation. Inspect its returned branch identity and origin addresses; no existing future is overwritten.
Reopen its result card and distinguish the new authored branch from the old source and a reader visit. Resolve inconsistent pictured difference counts against the declared fixture first.

journeys.title: Resume an interrupted investigation offline with equivalent access
steps: At integrated visit 03, keep the query, comparison, L17 cursors, source companions, package preferences, typed pouch and sibling reader route. Save/close through a presented control.
Replay a reopen card while offline. Restore exact identities before previews. Cached verified Review V4 remains readable; not-held media and incomplete search surfaces retain named statuses.
Use the proposed keyboard/list path to inspect the historical C17 reference, cycle a Link member and resume the chosen reader visit. Every action has a visible equivalent and named focus target.
Repeat the relevant inspection in a narrow layout, enlarged text and reduced motion. Access off-window cards, counted branch exits and both full endsets without pointer-only gestures.
Encounter unreadable saved reader data and a cancelled request. Preserve the data/descriptor and explain repair/retry options rather than regenerating a default session.
Reconnect, refresh the query and explicitly acquire a missing pinned edition. New results, publication pointers and package updates do not replace saved identities or enable new layers.
